items.title: The Analyst in the Prompt: Role, Retrieval, and Memory Biases in LLM Financial Analysis
items.claim: LLM financial analysis bias stems mostly from interpreting the same evidence differently across roles, not from retrieving different evidence.

items.title: Testing semi-strong market efficiency in Brazilian football: A risk-adjusted machine learning approach
items.claim: Machine learning models underperform Brazilian football betting odds.

items.title: Scaling Laws, Tabular Data and Actuarial Ratemaking Models
items.claim: TabM scales with data substantially better than Transformers or MLPs on actuarial tasks.
